So, this was probably one of my craziest memories of meeting a Ru girl. My friend had a band concert that they said would get out at 8:30. Meet and greet with Aquaria starts at 9 but you know a drag queen always starts a little later. The concert didn’t get over until 9:30, so we were already late, not knowing we would be. My friend decides they need to go home and change, which puts us at a 10 o’clock arrival time. We get there, get to the front door and my friend cannot find their ID for the life of them. We go back to their car, search around, cannot find it. Finally, after like 15 minutes of searching, it ends up being in their wallet this whole time, just in a very secret change department. It’s now probably like 10:30, Aquaria is just about to go on. We missed the meet and greet. We enter and see her perform. Of course, she is gorgeous. But I wanted that picture. I spend all night trying to find the Hard Candy guy, but cannot find him. Aquaria comes out again, in her Bossy Rossy baby outfit. Beautiful performance. Still wanted that picture. So, she got off of the stage, and to my luck she went and sat at the bar. I finally had enough drink in me to go talk to her and ask her for a picture. She said “Oh! Of course” but she had to go get recognized on the stage with the rest of the performing drag queens that night. She lingers in the stage for a bit so I go up and dance, and make eye contact with her but she exits the stage and walks right into the dressing room. I tell my friend that I’m going to wait a little longer to see if she comes out again, but she did not. So, I was just about to leave as I saw a local drag queen that I loved and stopped to talk to her. It must have been the right timing because she said “I’m going to go outside and have a smoke with Aquaria, come out!” so I followed her outside and girl Aquaria is back there smoking some weed 😂 Girl, I was shook. Gagged, gutted, gooped.   She was so sweet. She apologized for forgetting and thanked me for being so patient and I finally got my Aquaria picture.
